note: RFC 3161 trust anchors the verifier trusts, and ONLY these. tsa.py verifies each TSA's tokens against its pinned root (pinned intermediates offered as untrusted helpers); it never consults the system certificate store and never downloads a certificate. A rotated TSA chain therefore fails loudly until a release pins the new one (ERR-014).
